description.value: e’s BAR / The Dead Poet / Lilly’s Cocktail & Wine groups Upper West Side drinking spots for one evening. e's BAR describes itself as a neighborhood joint with good food, good drinks, fun games and smiling people, at 511 Amsterdam Ave between 84th and 85th. The Dead Poet opened in September of 2000 and celebrates famous writers, with mahogany-paneled walls and drinks named after authors. Walk-ins are welcome at e's BAR, which offers indoor and outdoor dining.
